components.description: A submitted award that broke a gate (cash budget, minimum service, order step, MOQ, unverified sample) is scored at the defer value less the information already bought; the cell's whole distance to the bound lands here.
components.label: award rejected at a gate

components.description: The episode ended without an award: an explicit defer, the action budget running out, or an action the environment could not parse. Scored at the defer value less the information bought.
components.label: no award: deferred, out of actions, or unparseable

components.description: Feasible awards: revenue lost and shortfall penalty added by completing fewer expected kits than the plan.
components.label: kits short of the full-information plan

components.description: Feasible awards: purchase, shipping and duty above the plan's.
components.label: landed price above the plan

components.description: Feasible awards: working capital, return freight and refund financing above the plan's, and expected refund recovery below it.
components.label: payment terms and returns

components.description: Feasible awards: quotes, samples, counter-offers and inquiries above what the plan itself buys.
components.label: information bought beyond the plan's
